tools.name: get_market_preview
tools.description: Get one live row from Lighter's perpetuals markets (symbol, mark price, 24h change %, 24h volume USD). Free, no account, reads Lighter's public API live. The full funding-rate/cross-exchange-spread snapshot is a separate paid HTTP route (GET /funding), not exposed over MCP.

tools.name: get_funding_snapshot
tools.description: Full funding-rate and cross-exchange-spread snapshot across venues. Requires payment (0.01 USDC on Base, x402) -- NOT callable for free over MCP. Calling this tool returns the exact HTTP request to make instead; it does not run the check itself. See GET /funding?... on this same origin.

tools.name: get_wallet_scan
tools.description: Token balances for one EVM address across 5 chains. Requires payment (0.05 USDC on Base, x402) -- NOT callable for free over MCP. Calling this tool returns the exact HTTP request to make instead; it does not run the check itself. See GET /wallet-scan?... on this same origin.
